risks.text: Crash versus destroy hinges on which intent is sent: sleep_actor(.., error) makes the engine put the actor back to sleep, stop_actor destroys the actor and its durable state and takes no error on purpose. A crash sent through stop_actor wipes data - engine/sdks/rust/envoy-client/src/handle.rs:197 (history 3f6314f)

The lost-connection path (stop_all_actors_lost) fails every pending kv/sqlite request and sends ToActor::Lost to every actor; a Lost stop must still surface as Stopped(Error), not a clean stop - engine/sdks/rust/envoy-client/src/envoy.rs:951 (history 4a2cd74)

HTTP streaming is credit-based: bodies are bounded by HTTP_STREAM_INITIAL_WINDOW_BYTES and the receiver must return cumulative window updates; the actor side also emits ToRivetResponseAbort on transport failure. Changing one side without the other stalls or leaks streams, and the streaming lifecycle hardening was once reverted - engine/sdks/rust/envoy-client/src/actor/http.rs:49 (history 5dad928)

v8 is both the latest and the oldest supported envoy protocol, so there are no converters and any other version is refused at decode. Editing v8.bare in place changes the wire format for every deployed RivetKit >= 2.3.20 host; lib.rs re-exports v8::* so a schema edit changes Rust types everywhere at once - engine/sdks/rust/envoy-protocol/src/versioned/mod.rs:6 (history 5dad928)

A response body channel can end with an out-of-band terminal error that Hyper only sees after queued data frames; setting it first-wins (fail ignores a second error) - engine/packages/guard-core/src/response_body.rs:41 (history 5dad928)

risks.text: Actor crashes (errored stop, dead SQLite worker) must go out as a sleep intent with an error, never as stop_actor; stop_with_error keeps a single error slot consumed by take(), so sending a second error-less intent races and reports the crash as a destroy - rivetkit-rust/packages/rivetkit-core/src/actor/context.rs:743 (history 3f6314f)

The schedule alarm marker (last_pushed_alarm) only dedupes pushes inside one generation; every actor start must force a re-push because a push can be acked locally and lost during drain, otherwise scheduled actions never fire - rivetkit-rust/packages/rivetkit-core/src/actor/context.rs:671 (history d2abe5d)

Websocket hibernation is decided per request by can_hibernate (config bool or callback) and defaults to off after a fix; flipping the default or leaving connections registered for hibernation changes who gets disconnected on sleep, and HTTP action connections must be removed when aborted - rivetkit-rust/packages/rivetkit-core/src/registry/mod.rs:1411 (history 22616c6, 6ca9b15)

lib.rs re-exports are public API for the Rust and NAPI bindings; the http body stream re-exports were dropped and restored once, so removing a pub use breaks downstream crates - rivetkit-rust/packages/rivetkit-core/src/lib.rs:129 (history d44805d)

native-runtime and wasm-runtime features are mutually exclusive and fail with compile_error; code under cfg(native-runtime) (engine_process, serverless_http) is absent in wasm builds - rivetkit-rust/packages/rivetkit-core/src/lib.rs:1

rules.rule: Report actor crashes through EnvoyHandle::sleep_actor with an error; call stop_actor only for a deliberate destroy.
rules.why: stop_actor makes the engine destroy the actor and its durable state, so a crash reported that way deletes user data.

rules.rule: Every actor start calls force_next_alarm_push before syncing the schedule alarm.
rules.why: The engine may have lost a previously acked alarm, and scheduled actions would silently never fire.

rules.rule: Do not change the shape of schemas/v8.bare or MIN_PROTOCOL_VERSION without adding a new version with converters.
rules.why: Deployed hosts on RivetKit >= 2.3.20 speak v8 and decoding any other version is refused, which disconnects them from the engine.

rules.rule: Keep both directions of HTTP body streaming on the window-update protocol and send a response abort when the transport fails.
rules.why: A missing window update stalls a request forever and a missing abort leaks the stream in the gateway.
